notes: Opening «وَ سَأَلَهُ:» gives a pronoun for the one asked and no named asker; the one asked is the Imam that prev3 (the nearest report that writes its chain, 776) names as the last link of its chain, so it is inherited
No asker is named here or in prev1 and prev2 (both have no written chain), so no narrator is added for the asker; this follows the rule for «و سأله» with no name
The Imam is the only link in this route
